note: ONE SPEC, TWO CONSUMERS. The C-BRIEF renders `requirement` into the coder's prompt so it builds toward the floor on the first pass; the Store gate executes `check` as its checklist. Neither side is hand-edited and neither may carry its own copy -- test_acceptance_floor_is_one_source fails if they drift. Order is the gate's reporting order and `authorship_floor` stays last.

checks.requirement: Every /v1 route refuses an unauthenticated request with HTTP 401. No route is open by accident.
checks.check: a request with no bearer token answers 401

checks.requirement: A payload missing a required field is refused with HTTP 422 naming the field. Never accept a partial record and fill the gap yourself.
checks.check: a payload missing a required field answers 422

checks.requirement: A field with a fixed vocabulary refuses a value outside it with HTTP 422. A status column that accepts any string is not a status column.
checks.check: a value outside a declared vocabulary answers 422

checks.requirement: app/static/index.html is served at / and is a working console: it discovers capabilities from the API and drives at least two of them against the real routes. A page that lists routes it never calls is a facade and fails this.
checks.check: GET / answers 200 and the page drives real capability routes

checks.requirement: If the product retrieves, an ingested document is findable again through the retrieval path, and the answer carries its authority label.
checks.check: a document ingested through the product is retrieved back

checks.requirement: One storage root, read from STORAGE_PATH. No second database, no stray sqlite file beside it.
checks.check: exactly one persistence root in the tree

checks.requirement: .github/workflows/ci.yml exists and runs the WHOLE suite, not a chosen subset.
checks.check: CI is committed and runs the full suite

checks.requirement: Each capability handler does its own work. Copies of one body with the names changed are refused.
checks.check: no two handler bodies are the same work

checks.requirement: /health reports unhealthy when a dependency it needs is down. A health check that answers 200 regardless is worse than none.
checks.check: /health fails closed on a broken dependency

checks.requirement: docs/openapi.json is committed and matches the routes actually served.
The image builds, boots, and answers its healthcheck before traffic. Build it and start it yourself before you claim this.
checks.check: the built image answers its healthcheck

checks.requirement: A record belonging to another tenant is invisible: reading it answers 404, never 403 and never the record. Tenancy is resolved from the authenticated principal, never from the payload.
Every action handler you author carries the authorship stamp in its module docstring.
